findings.title: EMR security configuration without at-rest encryption
findings.description: An EMR security configuration whose EncryptionConfiguration does not set EnableAtRestEncryption = true leaves cluster data unencrypted at rest.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: EMR security configuration without local disk encryption
findings.description: EMR clusters should encrypt local disks at rest. The security configuration JSON must set EnableAtRestEncryption to true. Absent or unparseable configuration is treated as undecidable.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.
